name: Saint Kitts and Nevis
alt: Federation of Saint Christopher and Nevis

predecessors.name: British Colonial Empire
predecessors.text: Saint Christopher-Nevis-Anguilla, the three islands of the associated state

ledger.x: 27 February 1967: Saint Christopher-Nevis-Anguilla becomes an associated state of the United Kingdom.
27 February 1967: the UK keeps external affairs and defence.
30 May 1967: Anguilla ejects the St Kitts police and leaves the union.
December 1980: Anguilla's separation from Saint Kitts and Nevis is made formal.
19 September 1983: the UK's responsibility for external affairs and defence ends with full independence.

19 September 1983: Saint Kitts and Nevis becomes fully independent as the Federation of Saint Christopher and Nevis ('Today, the Constitution refers to the state as both Saint Kitts and Nevis and Saint Christopher and Nevis'); same state, same land.

wars.name: Anguilla crisis (secession of Anguilla)
wars.outcome: Anguilla stayed out of the union: '300 British troops were sent to the island' in March 1969, British authority was 'confirmed by the Anguilla Act 1971 (c.

certainty.note: Island coasts; Anguilla's status is the exception for 1967-1980 (outside the state in fact from 1967, formally until 1980).
